shared_elements: small dark linear motifs arranged in a row/band
justification: Both present schematic, small-scale motifs distributed over a coarse stone-coloured surface, and each has a roughly horizontal band of repeated elements (the dark angular figures in A, the row of paired circular bosses across the torso in B). The rendering is entirely different, however: A is thin dark pigment painted onto cracked red-and-white plaster, while B is low-relief carving on a three-dimensional freestanding sculpted figure with a strongly vertical, body-shaped composition.
